purpose: Name-level alias map required by owner decision PD-02 (approved with modification on 2026-09-01). Its unit is one concrete legacy stage name observed in the frozen legacy tree, not a declaration site. Every name carries the surface on which it is observable, the legacy-stage-map declaration site it was read from, an immutable evidence locator resolvable with `git show`, and either a canonical registry stage or an explicit exclusion. This map is evidence and alias resolution only; the stage registry stays the sole target source of truth.
evidence_locator_format: <legacy_commit>:<path>:<symbol>@<line> or <legacy_commit>:<path>:<symbol>@<start>-<end>. The symbol is the literal source symbol at the start line; the range is the declaration region. evidence_literal is the exact substring proving the name inside that region and evidence_line is the line it occurs on.

resolution_kinds.canonical_stage: The legacy name resolves to exactly one canonical registry stage_id.
resolution_kinds.excluded: The legacy name is deliberately outside the analysis stage registry and names a registry excluded_scope entry.
